name: How to Write Your Own Story in 10 Minutes
source:
Gyan, a male high school student, is trying to write his own story for an assignment due in a week! But while looking for references in a school library, an expected disturbance comes to interfere with him.

[From [url=https://chaiyaproject.itch.io/htwyositm]itch.io[/url]]

吉安是一名男高中生，他正在尝试为一周内到期的作业写自己的故事！但当他在学校图书馆查找参考资料时，一场预料之中的骚乱来了，干扰了他。
